descricao_original: This cross section through a developing bone shows both lamellar and woven bone. The central portion is composed of circular osteons mixed with areas of woven bone. The bone is increasing in diameter by the addition of flattened lamellae on either side of this central region. The marrow cavity, visible to the far left, is lined by endosteum and contains red marrow. Lamellae are difficult to distinguish in this decalcified bone tissue. 200x

marcadores.explicacao_original: The interior and exterior surfaces are covered by lamellae of bone deposited in flat sheets, rather than being arranged in cylindrical Haversian systems. The exterior is covered by outer circumferential lamellae (black arrow); the interior is lined by inner circumferential lamellae (green arrow). These lamellae are laid down by the periosteum and the endosteum, respectively.
